description: The article identifies automated analysis techniques for detecting learners' internal argumentative scripts during CABLe.
title: Automated analysis of argumentative discourse for diagnostic learning analytics

description: The study adapted the Sharingan gaze-estimation framework (Tafasca et al., 2024), a pretrained transformer-based model reported with AUC 0.944, to derive joint attention and mutual gaze frame by frame from standard 2D video.
title: Automated computer-vision analysis of gaze and proxemics from classroom video

description: The dissertation organizes automated attention assessment around four data modalities — video, eye tracking, physiology, and interaction log files — from which attention indicators are extracted and combined with machine learning for prediction of attentional states.
title: Automated multimodal assessment of attention-related processes during learning
